name: 07436 · Oakland, NJ
findings: ZIP 07436 (Oakland) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07436 (Oakland) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07436 (Oakland) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 33% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Education organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 education organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
